newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Changan sets cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: China's Changan sets cash dividend.

text.p: Chongqing Changan Automobile Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would make a cash dividend payment of 0.0303 yuan per B share based on its 1996 earnings.
The dividend for B shareholders would be paid in Hong Kong dollars at an exchange rate of 1.0712 yuan to HK$1.00, the company said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
Changan's B shares would go ex-dividend on August 19, it said.
Changan, one of China's biggest auto makers, booked net profits of 202.83 million yuan for 1996 against 220.16 million yuan in 1995 under international accounting standards.
The company, based in the southwestern city of Chongqing, listed 250 million B shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in late 1996 and 83 million A shares in June this year, also in Shenzhen.
